newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates, bonds finish stable.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates, bonds finish stable.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates ended steady on Tuesday as banks adopted a cautious policy at the beginning of the new reserve period, dealers said.
The overnight interbank rate closed at 4.846 percent against Monday's 4.847 end, with 30-day commercial paper at 4.70-4.75 against 4.75-4.80.
Dealers expected the rates to stay around the current level before Thursday's National Day holiday.
The government bond yields were also little changed on caution that state-run Chinese Petroleum Corp may soon raise oil prices, triggering inflationary concern. -- Julie Hu (5080815)
